evidence: Sort by combobox set to Priority groups tasks High,High,High,Medium,Medium,Medium,Low correctly.
Switching Sort by to Deadline reorders tasks ascending by date: Jan1(overdue), Tomorrow, Sep4, Sep7, Sep9, Sep16, then no-deadline task last.
Add Task dialog allows creating a new task; "Test Past Date Task" and "Task A Dependency Test" were successfully created and appeared in the Active list with toast confirmation.
Create New Task dialog has Title (required), Description (optional), and Deadline (date) fields.

Prerequisites checklist in Create Task dialog allows selecting one or more existing tasks (e.g. bound "Schedule dentist appointment" as prerequisite for "Task A Dependency Test"); "Submit final report" shows "2 prerequisites incomplete" confirming multi-binding.

Tasks with incomplete prerequisites (Complete tax filing, Submit final report, Task A Dependency Test) show disabled/grayed complete and edit buttons (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed), while delete remains enabled.
Dependent tasks display a warning label e.g. 'Prerequisite "Review project proposal" incomplete' or "2 prerequisites incomplete" matching required behavior.
Complete (checkbox) button is rendered disabled for tasks with incomplete prerequisites, preventing completion until dependencies are done.
"Create Task" button remains disabled while the Title field is empty, preventing creation without a title.

actual: Created a task with deadline 2020-01-01 (past date); the app accepted it without error and displayed it as "Overdue: Jan 1" instead of preventing creation/selection of a past date.

evidence: Create Task button shows disabled styling (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed) when Title is empty, providing visual feedback that a title is required.
Hovering the dashed dependency connector (SVG path) and the "Prerequisite incomplete" badge triggers a tooltip titled "Dependency Chain" listing chain tasks with pending status.

issue: No generic hover details popup on tasks
actual: Hovering over a normal task card (e.g. "Buy groceries", "Review project proposal") triggers no pop-up/tooltip at all. Only hovering the dependency warning badge or connector line (a distinct dependency-specific feature) shows a tooltip. A generic "details pop-up on hover over the task" does not exist.

evidence: Edited "Buy groceries" task: changed description text and priority from Low to High via Edit dialog; changes persisted and reflected in the list immediately with a "Task updated" toast.
Successfully edited "Buy groceries" (Save Changes), completed it via the checkbox toggle, and deleted "Test Past Date Task" via the trash icon (toast confirmed "Task deleted").
Clicking the round checkbox on "Buy groceries" moved it out of Active (count 7->6) into Completed (count 2->3), confirmed present in Completed tab.
Active tab filters and displays only non-completed tasks (5 remaining after completing/deleting test tasks), separate from the Completed tab.

"Task A Dependency Test" has "Schedule dentist appointment" as its prerequisite. When editing "Schedule dentist appointment", the Prerequisites checklist excludes "Task A Dependency Test" as a selectable option, preventing the reverse/circular dependency.
Deadline field is a native type="date" input; typing an invalid date (month "13") results in an empty/rejected value rather than an invalid date string, enforcing correct date format.
After marking "Buy groceries" complete, it remains visible (not deleted) under the Completed tab with all its details intact.

Each task card on the main page displays the title (heading), due date (e.g. "Sep 4", "Tomorrow", "Overdue: Jan 1"), and completion status (Active vs Completed tab placement, plus a checkbox indicating completion state).
